svg.title: How to use VANES AI — animated four-step demo
svg.desc: An animated walkthrough drawn with the real VANES AI interface. Step 1: type one question per line in the Ask VANES coach panel. Step 2: the answer queue works through each question separately. Step 3: the planner creates a plan that saves to the Study Shelf and tracks study time. Step 4: the layout adapts to phone, tablet and desktop.
svg.text: How to use it — four steps, 28 seconds

g.text: Enter sends · Shift+Enter makes a new line · one question per line
⌑ marks a photo for analysis · ✧ generates a study image
Up to 6 questions per message — extras are reported, not dropped
Put each question on its own line.
English or Kiswahili — both are fine.
＋ New, ☰ History and ⌫ Clear sit in the panel head.
⌑ upload a photo of your work to be marked
↑ send — VANES answers them one by one
Plants use light energy, carbon dioxide and
water to make glucose and release oxygen.
Fotosintesis ni mchakato ambao mimea hutumia
⌫ Clear needs a second press within 3.5s — a mis-tap cannot wipe a session.
Every answer keeps the questions before it as context,
so “now in Kiswahili” still refers to the right topic.
01 · Read: structure of a leaf — 10 min
02 · Draw and label the diagram — 12 min
Save this study plan to Shelf
Study plan saved to your Study Shelf ✓
Start opens the workspace and begins timing the session
3 · Plan it, save it, track it
Finishing a session writes the minutes to the dashboard:
study time this week, current streak, curriculum progress.
The layout reshapes itself — no sideways scrolling from 320px to 1440px.
Install it as an app: browser menu → Add to Home screen, or the ⬇ Install button in the sidebar.

svg.text: Step 2 of 4 · VANES answers each one
